title: Bostrom Corporation: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS (12,500 affected)
summary: THE SEAT PEDESTALS ARE FATIGUE CRACKING ADJACENT TO THE WELD WHICH SECURES THE PEDESTAL'S UPPER PLATE TO THE UPPER, TELESCOPING PORTION OF THE ADJUSTABLE COLUMN SUPPORT.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: PACCAR/LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON (617 affected)
summary: THE WIRES THAT CORRESPOND TO THE VEHICLE'S REAR TURN SIGNALS WERE REVERSED WHEN INSTALLED IN THE ELECTRICAL CONNECTOR.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: ISUZU/LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:HEAD LIGHTS (1,547 affected)
summary: A BRAZILIAN DOMESTIC HEADLAMP WAS INADVERTENTLY INSTALLED ON THESE VEHICLES INSTEAD OF THE REQUIRED U.S. DOMESTIC ASSEMBLY. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (379,004 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE ASSEMBLED WITH THE THROTTLE CABLE CONTACTING THE DASH MAT WHICH COULD BIND THE THROTTLE. THIS DOES NOT MEET WITH THE MAXIMUM RETURN TIMES REQUIRED BY FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 124, "ACCELERATOR CONTROL SYSTEMS."

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: MERCEDES/ENGINE:PULLEY:CRANKSHAFT (149 affected)
summary: THE DRIVE BELT PULLEY ON THE ENGINE CAN DEVELOP FATIGUE CRACKS IN THE METAL AND BREAK. IF THE DRIVE PULLEY BREAKS, THE CAR WOULD NOT HAVE ENGINE COOLING, BATTERY CHARGING, AND/OR POWER STEERING.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/INTERIOR SYSTEMS:AIR BAG (700 affected)
summary: THE AIR BAG ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE (AECM) SOFTWARE CONTAINS AN ERROR WHICH CAN DELAY THE AIR BAG DEPLOYMENT IN CERTAIN CRASH SITUATIONS.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: THOMAS BUILT/STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR (37,717 affected)
summary: THE FASTENERS USED TO SECURE THE MOUNTING FOOT OF EITHER FORWARD OR REARWARD HANDRAILS COULD BE INSTALLED IN SUCH A MANNER AS TO ALLOW THE POSSIBILITY THAT THE NUT USED IN NHTSA'S HANDRAIL INSPECTION PROCEDURE WILL CATCH BETWEEN THE FASTENERS.

title: Load Rite Trailers, Inc.: LOAD RITE/EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES (752 affected)
summary: THE SPINDLE OF THE AXLE CAN TEAR OFF THE TOP OF THE AXLE TUBE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:FRONT (31,000 affected)
summary: THE WIRE HARNESS FOR THE POWER LUMBAR FEATURE ON THE SEAT IS UNDERNEATH THE FRONT SEAT CUSHION SUPPORT WIRES.  THE SUPPORT WIRES ON THE DRIVER SEAT CAN CONTACT AND DAMAGE THE INSULATION HARNESS RESULTING IN A HIGH RESISTANCE ELECTRICAL SHORT THROUGH THE SUPPORT WIRES.

title: Supreme Corporation: SUPREME/STRUCTURE:BUMPER ASSEMBLY (324 affected)
summary: THE REAR BUMPER BRACKET WELDS CAN CRACK.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:FITTINGS (43,213 affected)

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/BRAKES:AIR:DRUM AND SHOE SYSTEMS (108 affected)

title: WALKER STNLS.EQUIP.CO,INC: CARLISLE-WALKER/LIGHTING (123 affected)
summary: THE AFFECTED TRUCKS USE A SPLICED CABLE FOR CARRYING ELECTRICAL POWER TO THE REAR LIGHTING SYSTEM. CERTAIN SHRINK TUBING USED TO COVER THE SPLICE PERMITS CORRISION OF THE ELECTRICAL CABLE.

title: COACH & EQUIP SALES CORP.: COACH & EQUIPMENT/STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR (2,659 affected)

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: HOLIDAY RAMBLER/LIGHTING:FUSE:OTHER PART LIGHTING (494 affected)
summary: THE FUSE FOR THE DAYTIME RUNNING LIGHT CIRCUIT MAY BE UNDER RATED FOR THESE MOTORHOMES. THE CIRCUIT REQUIRES A 20 AMP FUSE AND A 15 AMP FUSE MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED. ALSO THE CIRCUIT CONNECTING THE DAYTIME RUNNING LIGHTS TO THE FUSE PANEL INCORRECTLY STATES 15 AMP.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION (7,900,000 affected)
